paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on BioGPT and Llama2, where “Base” denotes LLM without editing.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy change (ACC) percentage as a function of co-occurrence number for various editing methods. The x-axis is linear and ranges from 1.0 to 10^10, with tick marks spaced by orders of magnitude, and the values are expressed in base-10 notation. The y-axis represents the ACC percentage, ranging from approximately 60% to 80%, with tick marks spaced by 5%. The ‘Base’ line, depicted in black and represented by circular markers, shows a steady decline from approximately 68% at a co-occurrence number of 1.0 to 63% at a co-occurrence number of 10^10. The ‘FT’ line, shown in teal and indicated by triangular markers, increases from approximately 65% at 1.0 to 78% at 10^10. The ‘MEMIT’ line, in magenta with a square marker, starts at approximately 62% at 1.0 and ends at approximately 73% at 10^10. The ‘IKE’ line, in cyan with a diamond marker, begins at approximately 66% at 1.0 and has a value of approximately 75% at 10^10. Finally, the ‘ROME’ line, in green and represented by a hexagonal marker, starts at approximately 64% at 1.0 and maintains a value of approximately 77% through the x-axis range.
